title: Decide what the tools process may read in EVA-03, and make eva run-tools-03 start
goal: `nerv eva run-tools-03` lists the tools from a checkout under $HOME, reading only what the decision allows
acceptance: Test committed failing first: runToolsProcessInEva03 from a checkout under the denied $HOME exits 0 and lists tools

The profile allows only what the tools process needs (directory metadata above its read-only paths, the checkout's package.json, the config it is given); NERV state, keys and the rest of $HOME stay denied, and the gate tests still pass
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: Allowing the tools process to read NERV state (its config) is a security decision for the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 from the probe in F-049-T13. Not a measurement.
